documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement On Opening Of New Showroom
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers reported a 60% year-on-year revenue growth for Q1 FY27, reaching INR 121 crores, with EBITDA margins at 14.9%. The company is actively expanding its retail footprint in Gujarat, with four new stores scheduled to open across Q2 and Q3 FY27. Management is transitioning toward a more asset-light model by increasing the use of Gold Metal Loans (GML) to hedge inventory and improve return on equity. The long-term strategy focuses on achieving a 75:25 retail-to-wholesale revenue mix while maintaining a strong presence in the antique gold bridal jewellery segment.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects positive performance in Q2 based on current order trends.
demand_outlook.quote: I think Quarter 2, we think that because of the orders and all, we are hoping that performance will be very much in line with whatever we have projected in earlier commentaries.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch four new stores in Gujarat during Q2 and Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3. And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself.

capex_expansion.claim: The capital expenditure for the Surat store is approximately INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter were 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Higher employee expenses and lease-related costs impacted margins during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So, because of these two also, there has been a sluggishness in margins. And because of Surat store opening, in the month of September, we have already booked, we have already offered and engaged the employees for the BTL activities and training and stuff.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's factory capacity utilization is approximately 50%.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year. And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is progressively moving toward hedging its inventory using Gold Metal Loans.
capital_allocation.quote: So slowly and steadily, yes, we are moving towards hedging. And basically, hedging means use of GML.

capital_allocation.claim: Management aims to reach a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.5:1 or 2:1 over time.
capital_allocation.quote: Over the period of time we are wanting to gear up this to 1.5 or 2:1 debt equity ratio, wherein major leverage will be through Gold Metal Loan

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve capex break-even for new stores within one year.
management_commitments.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

management_commitments.claim: The long-term revenue mix target is 75% retail and 25% wholesale.
management_commitments.quote: in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
